case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for the open way you explained your labour costs. We value the craftsmanship and trust between our companies, and we want to continue the cooperation on a solid basis.

Your proposed price is higher than we can accept. We have therefore prepared three genuine options. A longer contract term gives you planning security, and the options with a longer payment term or a later start date allow different timing for the new price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.39; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-01-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 46.25; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-04-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.64; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Please let us know which option suits you best.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your constructive approach and the offer of a 24-month contract, which provides valuable planning security for both sides. For generations, our family foundry has built its reputation on strong craftsmanship and enduring partnerships, and we deeply value our long relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. 

We are willing to accept the extended contract term and the start date of 1 January 2027 as proposed in your Option A. In return for these adjustments, we can offer a revised price of €51.40 per unit. Our present Angebot thus stands at a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and are willing to accept the later start date of 1 February 2027 as proposed in your Option B. In exchange for this adjustment, we can reduce our price to €50.70 per unit while maintaining the 30-day payment term. 

For our current Angebot, we offer a price of €50.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

We look forward to discussing the volume forecast once we have finalized these terms. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. It is always a pleasure working with your esteemed company.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
